title: Cash Pickup Name-Correction Fee: Share When a Reactivation Fee Is on the Transfer
content:
**Pricing annex: bundle share.** When a Cash Pickup transfer already carries a reactivation fee charge, a name correction on it is charged only a share of the tier's name-correction fee. The share depends on two things: the transfer's ledger, and its refused pickups.

| A reactivation fee charge stands on the transfer's ledger | Pickups refused because the name on the ID did not match | Share of the tier's name-correction fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| yes | at least one | 50 percent |
| yes | none | 75 percent |
| no | at least one | 100 percent: the whole fee |
| no | none | 100 percent: the whole fee |

"A reactivation fee charge stands" means the transfer's money movements carry at least one reactivation fee charge.

**What the share acts on.** The share applies to the tier's listed name-correction fee alone. The bundle-shared fee is the tier's name-correction fee multiplied by the share, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical)

| Tier's listed fee | Reactivation fee charge on the ledger | Name-mismatch refusals | Bundle-shared fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5.00 | yes | 2 | 2.50 |
| 5.00 | yes | 0 | 3.75 |
| 10.00 | yes | 0 | 7.50 |
| 10.00 | no | 1 | 10.00 |
